purpose: Teach: ボーダフォン/サラ金/マーチ/ワーム/ヒューザー/プッシュ/エクスプレス/光ファイバー

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 旧ボーダフォン回線の契約を見直しましょう
lines.en: Let's review the contract terms on the old Vodafone lines.
lines.style: Measured, businesslike tone. Clear enunciation on key terms. Steady pace without rushing. Sounds like someone moving down a checklist with quiet competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員向けにサラ金被害の啓発資料を配ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare and distribute awareness materials about loan fraud for all staff.
lines.style: Attentive, responsive. Slight uptake on 'Yes'—showing engagement. Even pacing. Sounds like someone taking notes while listening, reliable.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社用車に日産マーチを追加導入しましょう
lines.en: And let's add Nissan Marches to the company vehicle fleet.
lines.style: Calm directive. Even weight on the proposal. Professional but not stiff. Slight breath between the suggestion and the model name, as if checking a list.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内端末のワーム検査を全台実施します
lines.en: Understood. I'll run a malware check on all office terminals.
lines.style: Confirming without ceremony. Quick, competent. The tone of someone who's already mentally moved to the next task. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 旧ヒューザーの耐震偽装事件の事例研修を組みましょう
lines.en: Let's set up a case study training on the old Huizer seismic falsification incident.
lines.style: Deliberate, measured direction. Weight on 'case study'—the gravity of the material beneath. Not rushed. Sounds like someone who knows this matters for context.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品のプッシュキャンペーンを準備します
lines.en: Right. I'll get the push campaign for the new product line ready.
lines.style: Brief affirmation. Lighter, quicker than the previous response. The rhythm of someone moving through steps efficiently, energized.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: エクスプレス便のコストを見直しましょう
lines.en: Let's take another look at express delivery costs.
lines.style: Steady proposal. Mid-register. Conversational but focused. The tone of someone returning to familiar ground—practical, not negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。光ファイバー配線工事の業者を選定します
lines.en: Yes. I'll select a contractor for the fiber-optic cable installation work.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Calm, controlled close. Slight settling-in of the voice—this is the last item. Professional, decisive, no loose ends.
